items.stem: Which imaging modality uses a strong magnetic field and radio waves rather than ionising radiation?

options.rationale: Correct: MRI uses magnetic fields and radiofrequency pulses, not ionising radiation.
PET uses radioactive tracers, i.e. ionising radiation.

items.explanation: Correct: MRI uses magnetic fields and radiofrequency pulses, not ionising radiation.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about ultrasound are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: ultrasound forms images from reflected sound waves.

options.text: It does not use ionising radiation
options.rationale: Correct: ultrasound is a non-ionising modality.

options.text: It is the best modality for imaging dense bone interiors
options.rationale: Sound does not penetrate dense bone well; X-ray/CT suit bone.

options.text: It always requires an intravenous contrast injection
options.rationale: Most ultrasound is performed without injected contrast.

options.text: It exposes the patient to a high radiation dose

items.explanation: Correct: ultrasound forms images from reflected sound waves.
